TSB Revision
SIMPLIFIED WIRING SYSTEM (SWS)
54B-275
Inspection Procedure O-19: The windshield intermittent wiper interval adjusting knob signal is not 
sent to the ETACS-ECU.
CIRCUIT OPERATION
The ETACS-ECU calculates the windshield 
intermittent wiper interval according to the resistance 
of the windshield intermittent wiper interval adjusting 
knob, which is incorporated in the column switch 
(windshield wiper and windshield washer switch).
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
If the windshield intermittent wiper interval adjusting 
knob is defective, the windshield intermittent wiper 
interval can not be adjusted.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of the column switch
• Malfunction of the ETACS-ECU
• Damaged harness wires or connectors
